project.name: Brightloop Software
project.description: Enterprise Subscription & Recurring Revenue Management Platform

scenes.title: Brightloop — Next-Gen Subscription Management
scenes.narration: Welcome to Brightloop Software — a modern, resilient subscription management and recurring revenue platform engineered for high-concurrency SaaS operations.
scenes.slot_notes: Title branding sequence with animated glow.

scenes.title: The Recurring Revenue Dilemma
scenes.narration: Modern businesses struggle with fractured subscription lifecycles, race conditions in automated billing runs, duplicate invoices, and manual payment reconciliations that bleed revenue.
scenes.slot_notes: Visualizing revenue leakage and concurrency race conditions.

scenes.title: Engineered for Financial Correctness
scenes.narration: Brightloop solves this from the ground up. Combining strict transaction boundaries, database-enforced state machines, and transparent customer self-service, it guarantees financial correctness at every step.

scenes.title: Modern Full-Stack Architecture
scenes.narration: Built on Node.js 24, Express 5, React 19, and PostgreSQL 16 with Prisma ORM. Strict OpenAPI 3.1 contracts ensure seamless type safety and security across the entire stack.

scenes.title: Workspace & Role-Based Access Control
scenes.narration: Brightloop features role-based access control, session-based authentication with CSRF protection, and segregated workspaces for administrators, billing specialists, and customers.
scenes.slot_notes: REPLACEABLE SLOT 1: Replace with live screen capture of admin/staff workspace and authentication.

scenes.title: Deterministic Subscription Lifecycle
scenes.narration: Subscriptions follow a rigorous lifecycle from quotation to activation. Plan policies enforce pause intervals, renewal rules, and automatic closures, backed by atomic database constraints.
scenes.slot_notes: REPLACEABLE SLOT 2: Replace with live screen capture of subscription creation, quotation, and activation.

scenes.title: Transactional Billing & Payment Tracking
scenes.narration: Billing runs utilize database-level advisory locking and recovery leases to guarantee crash safety. Invoices calculate precise tax and discount rules, with idempotent payment recording.
scenes.slot_notes: REPLACEABLE SLOT 3: Replace with live screen capture of invoice generation, tax/discount calculation, and payment registration.

scenes.title: Customer Self-Service Portal
scenes.narration: Customers enjoy a dedicated self-service portal to review active subscriptions, download invoices, and inspect payment histories — completely isolated at the database level.
scenes.slot_notes: REPLACEABLE SLOT 4: Replace with live screen capture of customer portal self-service view.

scenes.title: High-Performance Analytics & Verification
scenes.narration: Our reporting persistence layer delivers sub-second analytics across 100,000 invoices under RepeatableRead transaction snapshots — fully verified for enterprise scale.
scenes.slot_notes: REPLACEABLE SLOT 5: Replace with live screen capture of reports dashboard with real-time filters.

scenes.title: Brightloop — Built for Scale & Reliability
scenes.narration: Brightloop: predictable recurring revenue, bulletproof persistence, and exceptional user experience. Built with passion for the Odoo Hackathon.
